BrochureContent.Content:
iMOVE are delighted to present this impressive four-bedroom home at Raheny Close to the sales market.

This bright and stylish semi-detached residence is presented in excellent condition throughout and offers generous, well-balanced accommodation arranged over two levels. Situated within a modern residential development in the heart of Lusk, the property represents an excellent opportunity for buyers seeking a spacious, energy-efficient family home in a convenient village setting.

The ground-floor accommodation comprises a welcoming entrance hall, a spacious living room and a bright open-plan kitchen/dining area. The contemporary fitted kitchen offers excellent storage and a practical layout for everyday family living and entertaining. A separate utility room provides additional convenience.

Upstairs, there are four well-proportioned bedrooms, including a generous principal bedroom with en-suite bathroom and walk-in wardrobe/storage area. A modern family bathroom and additional storage complete the first-floor accommodation. There is also a guest WC at ground-floor level.

Outside, the property enjoys a private rear garden, providing an ideal space for outdoor dining, children’s play or relaxation. To the front, the house features an attractive red-brick exterior and a neatly landscaped approach.

The property benefits from solar panels and an excellent A2 BER rating, providing a high level of energy efficiency and the potential for reduced running costs.

Raheny Close enjoys a convenient location close to the centre of Lusk village, with an excellent selection of shops, schools, cafés, sports clubs and other local amenities nearby. Rush, Skerries and Swords are all within easy reach, while the M1 motorway provides convenient access to Dublin Airport and Dublin City Centre.

This is a superb opportunity to acquire a modern, energy-efficient family home in a highly convenient North County Dublin location.

Viewing is highly recommended.

Key features:

* Four-bedroom semi-detached residence
* Presented in excellent condition throughout
* Principal bedroom with en-suite
* Three bathrooms
* Spacious living room
* Open-plan kitchen and dining area
* Separate utility room
* Walk-in wardrobe and excellent storage
* Private rear garden
* Attractive red-brick exterior
* Solar panels
* Energy-efficient A2 BER rating
* Convenient Lusk village location
* Close to schools, shops, cafés and sporting amenities
* Easy access to Rush, Skerries, Swords and the M1
* Convenient to Dublin Airport and Dublin City Centre
